newsitem.title: USA: Sparta Foods completes financing package.
newsitem.headline: Sparta Foods completes financing package.

text.p: Sparta Foods Inc said Monday it completed a $1,950,000 financing package with the State of Minnesota.

On July 2, the Minnesota Agricultural and Economic Development Board issued a single lot Series 1997D bonds with a final maturity of August 1, 2008. Proceeds from this tax-exempt bond issue were loaned to Sparta Foods under the board's Small Business Development Loan Program at an interest rate of 5.79 percent through August 1, 2008.
Sparta Foods said it will use the proceeds from this loan to purchase new equipment in connection with the company's relocation to an expanded facility.

Sparta Foods said it previously announced plans to relocate its manufacturing operations and executive offices to a newly leased 112,000-square-foot facility in New Brighton, Minn., from present facilities in St. Paul.
Sparta Foods makes and distributes tortillas and tortilla products to the food service and retail foods industries.
